mapper.select: SELECT region.region_id as area_id, region.region_name as area_name, f.up_region_id as bay_id, f.up_region_name as bay_name, a.instance_id as device_id, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name) END) AS device_name, f.custom_id as component_id, f.custom_name as component_name, f.device_id as main_device_id, f.device_name as main_device_name, j.up_dict as device_type, case b.meter_type when 411 then '1' when 412 then '2' when 413 then '3' when 414 then '4' when 415 then '5' when 416 then '6' when 417 then '7' when 418 then '8' when 419 then '9' end as meter_type, -- b.meter_type, b.appearance_type, "" as save_type_list, k.dict_note as recognition_type_list, "" as phase, "" as device_info, "" as data_type, "" as lower_value, "" as upper_value, "" as video_pos, "" as appearance_type, a.cruise_type , c.inspection_id, d.preset_id, robot.robot_code, d.camera_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON a.cruise_id = c.inspection_id left join t_robot_info robot on c.robot_id = robot.robot_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON a.cruise_id = d.preset_id left join t_std_device f on a.device_id = f.device_id and a.custom_id = f.custom_id left join t_std_region re on f.up_region_id = re.region_id left join t_std_region region on re.up_region_id = region.region_id left join t_dict_business j on f.device_type = j.dict_code left join t_dict_business k on a.cruise_type = k.dict_code

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%c-%d %h:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, '' as place, (CASE WHEN a.robot_position = 155 THEN '2' WHEN a.robot_position = 156 THEN '1' WHEN a.robot_position = 399 THEN '3' end) as type, '' as patroldevcie_info, '' as robots_code from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.robot_type is not null

select a.robot_name as patroldevice_name, a.robot_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, a.building_user as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, DATE_FORMAT(a.commission_date, '%Y-%c-%d %h:%i:%s') as production_date, a.appearance_number as production_code, if(b.dict_code = 399, 0, 1) as istransport, '' as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.light_ip is null AND a.lnferad_IP is null THEN '' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) > 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) = 0 THEN '2' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) = 0 and locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) > 0 THEN '1' WHEN locate('.', a.light_ip) AND locate('.', a.lnferad_IP) THEN '3' else '' end) as video_mode, '' as place, (CASE WHEN a.robot_position = 155 THEN '2' WHEN a.robot_position = 156 THEN '1' WHEN a.robot_position = 399 THEN '3' end) as type, '' as patroldevcie_info, '' as robots_code from t_robot_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.robot_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.robot_factory = c.dict_code where a.drone_type is not null

select a.voice_device_name as patroldevice_name, a.voice_code as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, '亿嘉和' as use_unit, '亿嘉和' as device_source, '' as production_date, '' as production_code, '' as istransport, '' as use_mode, '' as video_mode, '' as place, '14' as type, '' as patroldevcie_info, '' as robots_code from t_voice_device a left join t_dict_business b on a.voice_type = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.voice_factory = c.dict_code

select a.camera_name as patroldevice_name, a.camera_id as patroldevice_code, b.dict_note as device_model, c.dict_note as manufacturer, "" as use_unit, c.dict_note as device_source, '' as production_date, '' as production_code, '' as istransport, if(a.is_control = 1, '11', '10') as use_mode, (CASE WHEN a.camera_type = 205 THEN '1' WHEN a.camera_type = 206 THEN '2' end) as video_mode, a.address as place, '10' as type, '' as patroldevice_info, '' as robots_code from t_camera_info a left join t_dict_business b on a.camera_model = b.dict_code left join t_dict_business c on a.vendor_id = c.dict_code

SELECT b.up_dict as type, a.task_id as task_code, a.task_name, a.task_level as priority, "3" as device_level, -- IFNULL(a.date_type, "") as time, "" as cycle_month, "" as cycle_week, "" as cycle_execute_time, "" as cycle_start_time, "" as cycle_end_time, "" as interval_number, "" as interval_type, "" as interval_execute_time, "" as interval_start_time, "" as interval_end_time, "" as invaild_start_time, "" as invaild_end_time, '0' isenable, u.user_name as creator, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%c-%d %h:%i:%s') as fixed_start_time, "" as create_time from t_cruise_task a left join sys_user u on a.create_user_id = u.user_id left join t_dict_business b on a.type = b.dict_code and b.col_name="plan_type" left join t_cruise_result c on a.task_id = c.task_id

select maintenance_id, maintenance_name, device_id, is_valid , DATE_FORMAT(maintenance_start, '%Y-%c-%d %h:%i:%s') as maintenance_start, DATE_FORMAT(maintenance_stop, '%Y-%c-%d %h:%i:%s') as maintenance_stop from t_device_maintenance

select count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from t_cruise_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and c_state = 240) as validNum from t_cruise_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and c_state in (240,242,243,244)

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, count(t.deal_type) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1)) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}
SELECT robot_id as id, robot_code as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, commission_date as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_type IS NOT NULL
SELECT camera_id as id, camera_id as patrolDeviceCode, camera_name as patrolDeviceName, create_time as commissionTime FROM t_camera_info
SELECT robot_id as id, robot_code as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, commission_date as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE drone_type IS NOT NULL
select phote_path from t_robot_info where phote_path is not null limit 1
